name: Silicon Circle
summary: Tech billionaires who discovered that algorithms and sigils are not so different. Their coven worships at the altar of data and dark code.
lore: The Silicon Circle learned that the most powerful magic is indistinguishable from sufficiently advanced technology — and vice versa. Their rituals run on server farms, their prayers on neural networks.

events.title: The Tourist Wave
events.narrative: Witch tourism season brings a flood of visitors to Salem. Some are curious; some are searching; some are dangerous.

events.title: The Dark Web
events.narrative: A contact on the dark web offers to sell you a grimoire scanned from a restricted Vatican archive.

choiceB.label: Report the seller to maintain cover

events.title: The Investor Pitch
events.narrative: A venture capitalist offers funding for your 'wellness brand' — a front for the coven. She wants 20% and a seat on the board.

choiceA.label: Take the money and maintain control

events.title: The Ghost Hunters
events.narrative: A reality TV crew arrives to film 'paranormal activity' in your territory. They have real equipment and no fear.

choiceA.label: Let them film and subtly feed them scares

choiceB.label: Ward the area and scare them off

events.title: The FBI Investigation
events.narrative: An agent starts asking questions about your organization. She is smart, persistent, and dangerously close to the truth.

choiceA.label: Feed her a convincing cover story

choiceB.label: Use magic to redirect her attention

random.winMessage: Your ward works. She loses interest and moves on. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: She senses the magic and redoubles her efforts. Four followers panic and leave. -4 Followers.

events.title: The Hurricane
events.narrative: A massive storm bears down on your territory. Your followers look to you for protection.

events.title: The Crypto Coven
events.narrative: A group of crypto-wealthy occultists offers to fund your coven with cryptocurrency — if you perform a ritual to bless their tokens.

events.title: The Old House
events.narrative: A member discovers a 200-year-old house on their property with a sealed cellar. Something is breathing inside.

choiceA.label: Break the seal and claim what's within

choiceB.label: Ward the house and leave it sealed

events.title: The Viral Video
events.narrative: A follower posts a video of your ritual that goes viral. Millions of views overnight — and not all viewers are human.

choiceB.label: Scrub the video and go dark

events.title: The Winter Blackout
events.narrative: A massive blackout plunges your territory into darkness for three days. Your followers huddle in candlelight.

choiceB.label: Organize mutual aid and build loyalty
